relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: PAC administration decreased the length of neurites and upregulated the expression of TRPV1 in 50B11 cells

relationships.subject: TMI-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of TRPV1 was reversed by the administration of 4 ng/ml TMI-1 compared with administration of paclitaxel alone.

relationships.subject: TMI-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with TMI-1 reduced the secretion of soluble TNF-α and expression of TRPV1 in DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: TMI-1
relationships.evidence_quote: TMI-1 inhibits the enzymatic activity of ADAM17 and MMPs by binding zinc at the catalytic site

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Secretion of TNF-α was significantly increased in 50B11 cells treated with 100 ng/ml paclitaxel

key_findings: TMI-1 partially protects 50B11 DRG cells from paclitaxel neurotoxicity, reversing TRPV1 upregulation and lowering TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-6.
TMI-1 also reduced paclitaxel-induced calcium, PKC, PI3K, NF-κB and MAPK signaling.
